Name: Icy Abigail Recolor
Author: ClumsyLavellan
Description:
Changes the hair color of all of Abigail's portraits and sprites, including her beach and winter stuff, to an icy blue. I changed the color of her normal outfit and her winter outfit to purple (I left her bathing suit black cause I was lazy. I [i]might[/i] update it later.).

This is my first mod and was just some fun practice! Let me know if there are any problems.

Requires content patcher. Unzip the mod file into your Stardew Mods folder as normal.

Manifest.Name: Abigail Icy
Manifest.Description: Changes Abigail's hair color to an icy blue.
Manifest.Author: ClumsyLavellan
